messages:
julia_sec: Quick recap from the Acme sec call earlier — they want (1) proof of tenant key separation, (2) an audit-log export for the last 90 days, (3) an RBAC matrix showing who can export logs and rotate keys, and (4) confirmation of on-prem HSM support. Need response by Tue EOD. :alarm_clock:
raj_sre: Got it. I'll own the log export example + retention numbers. Can we provide a redacted sample export (no PII)? :+1:
mike_prod: I'll prepare the RBAC matrix and a list of service accounts. CSV okay for them?
anna_privacy: CSV is fine but we must ensure we redact user IDs and tenant identifiers. I can run a pseudonymization pass and produce a redaction log.
raj_sre: For the log export, here's a typical example we can include in the package — they asked for an executable sample:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  "https://logs.redwood.ai/api/v1/exports?tenant=acme&start=2025-12-01&end=2026-03-01&format=jsonl" > acme-export.jsonl
```

We should include one JSONL sample line and a short note about which fields are stripped.
julia_sec: Good. Also they asked about key management — specifically "who can access unwrapped keys" and "rotation cadence." We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with envelope encryption; can someone draft a one-paragraph explanation we can hand them?
anna_privacy: Draft paragraph: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK). The platform uses envelope encryption: per-tenant data keys are generated and encrypted (wrapped) by the customer's CMK stored in their KMS/HSM. Only the cryptography service and authorized operator roles may request unwrap operations; all key usage is restricted by IAM roles and audited in key access logs. Customers retain control of CMKs and may rotate or revoke as per their policies." I'll paste the full version into a doc.
mike_prod: Rotation notes for the customer-facing statement: default rotation policy for ephemeral data keys is 90 days. Tenant CMKs are managed by the customer for BYOK; rotations can be scheduled or customer-triggered. We rewrap data keys during rotation as part of the standard workflow.
raj_sre: RBAC matrix format I'll produce as CSV with headers: role,scope,permissions,actors. Permissions will be comma-separated tokens, e.g., read_logs,export_logs,rotate_keys,manage_keys. Actors column will list humans or service identities.
julia_sec: They also want "evidence of separation of duties" — a short narrative plus a redacted audit trail showing rotation workflow (request -> approval -> execution). Can we extract a tiny redacted timeline showing actor names as service/human without tenant identifiers?
raj_sre: Yes, here's a redact-ready snippet we can include:

{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:01:22Z","actor":"svc-key-operator","action":"rotation_initiated","target":"tenant:acme"}
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:01:35Z","actor":"human-ops-admin","action":"rotation_approved","target":"tenant:acme"}
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:01:50Z","actor":"svc-key-service","action":"rotation_completed","target":"tenant:acme"}

All personally identifiable fields removed.
anna_privacy: I'll run the redaction script and generate an attestation statement: "We have reviewed exported artifacts to remove tenant identifiers and personal data prior to delivery." I'll sign it and include a hash of the export file.
julia_sec: Who will assemble the deliverables into one secure bundle and send to Acme? Also include the secure share link TTL and password notes.
mike_prod: I'll assemble and upload to the secure share. Please send me the recipient contact so I can grant access.
julia_sec: Use sec-requests@acme-corp.com. Note: share links expire in 7 days by default; include instructions for one-time download if they need longer.
sec-bot: Reminder: create task in #incidents for "acme security evidence deliverable" due 2026-03-15. Created ticket INC-4072.
raj_sre: One last ask from them: vuln triage flow for Severity >= P1. We'll include the runbook link and a short summary: P1 -> triage within 1 hour, engage on-call, create mitigation timeline, notify customers per SLA, postmortem within 30 days. Runbook: https://go.redwood.ai/runbooks/vuln-triage
julia_sec: Perfect. Let's meet Thu 10am to review artifacts before sending. :calendar: 
mike_prod: I'll drop the CSV + export sample in the private drive by Wed noon.
anna_privacy: I'll add the attestation and redaction log.
julia_sec: Thanks team — tag me when done. :thumbsup:
